create.label: Add membership

end.label: End membership
end.confirm: Do you really want to end the membership?
end.error: The membership could not be ended.
end.intro:
The exit date is the last day of the membership. From the next day on, the person is no longer a member.
Usually this is 31.12. of the current year.

delete.label: Delete membership
delete.group: Should this group membership really be deleted?
delete.confirm: Normally a membership should be ended, but not deleted. Deletion is only intended to correct incorrect entries. Do you really want to delete the membership?

category.helper: The member category is fixed here. If you want to change it, choose the Category change action in the list view.
category.name: Name of the category

change.label: Change member category
change.helper: On the left you see the current member category. On the right, select the new category the member should switch to.
change.helperDate: The date from which the new category should apply. The current membership is ended one day earlier. By default, today's date is suggested.

state.label: Member status
state.helper: The current status of this membership.

archive.confirm: The invoice run is completed and all invoices are set to archived.

generate.confirm: WARNING: All invoices will be regenerated. Local changes will be overwritten. Normally this operation is run once at the start of an invoice run. Should the operation be executed?

upload.label: Invoice review
